text: answer thou me: Heb. make me know
if thou hast understanding: Heb. if thou knowest understanding
foundations: Heb. sockets | fastened?: Heb. made to sink | thy proud waves: Heb. the pride of thy waves
brake up for it my decreed place: Or, established my decree upon it
Pleiades?: Or, the seven stars. Heb. Cimah | Orion?: Heb. Cesil
Mazzaroth: Or, the twelve signs | guide: Heb. guide them
here we are?: Heb. behold us
who can stay: Heb. who can cause to lie down
when the dust: Or, when the dust is turned into mire: | groweth: Heb. is poured
